description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteEditor' which provides a user interface for editing and previewing notes, including markdown processing, and manages note updates and deletion within a note-taking application.

methods.name: markdownToHtml
methods.description: Converts markdown text to simplified HTML for preview.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: React component that renders the note editing UI, manages local state for title and content, handles switching between edit and preview modes, and supports note update and deletion.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current note content and title, switches to read-only mode.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current note after user confirmation.
